ssh_mesh.title: SSH access
ssh_mesh.enabled_hint: The workspace SSH key is being distributed to platform and Runtime nodes.
ssh_mesh.disabled_hint: SSH access is not configured for this workspace.

ssh_mesh.emergency_disable_description: This emergency action cannot be undone for the keys currently being distributed.
ssh_mesh.emergency_disable_revoke_keys: Revoke both the current and previous workspace keys immediately.

ssh_mesh.fleet_hint: Latest SSH endpoint and key status reported by each daemon.
ssh_mesh.fleet_empty: No daemons have reported SSH configuration yet.
ssh_mesh.platform_nodes_hint: Hosts the Multiremi service and does not run Agent tasks.
ssh_mesh.platform_nodes_empty: The platform node has not reported SSH configuration yet.
ssh_mesh.runtime_nodes_hint: Daemon hosts that run Agent tasks.
ssh_mesh.runtime_nodes_empty: No Runtime nodes have reported SSH configuration yet.
ssh_mesh.other_nodes_hint: Nodes reported by a newer server type.
ssh_mesh.other_nodes_empty: No other SSH nodes have reported configuration.
ssh_mesh.connectivity_hint: Direct SSH results from the selected source to each target.
ssh_mesh.source_missing: The selected source is not available in SSH access.
ssh_mesh.no_peers: At least two SSH nodes are required to test connectivity.
ssh_mesh.error_invalid_response: The server returned an invalid SSH access response. Refresh and try again.
ssh_mesh.error_expiring_credentials: One or more daemons use expiring credentials. Remove and reconnect them before enabling SSH access.
ssh_mesh.error_forbidden: Your permission to manage SSH access has changed. Refresh the page.
ssh_mesh.error_conflict: SSH access changed in another session. Refresh and try again.
ssh_mesh.error_server_setup: SSH access isn't configured on the server. Check the encryption key and ssh-keygen setup.
ssh_mesh.error_network: The server couldn't be reached. Check the connection and try again.

online.label: Online
online.description: Heartbeat received in the last 45s. Ready to dispatch tasks.

recently_lost.label: Recently lost
recently_lost.description: Lost contact under 5 minutes ago — often a brief network blip.

offline.label: Offline
offline.description: No heartbeat for 5+ minutes. Restart the daemon or investigate the host.

about_to_gc.label: About to GC
about_to_gc.description: Offline 6+ days. Auto-deleted at 7 days unless it reconnects.

visibility_hint.public: Any workspace member can create agents on this runtime.

cascade.notice_runtime_delete_plan_changed: The active agent set changed while this dialog was open. Review the new plan and confirm.

cascade.checkbox_other: I understand these {{count}} agents will be archived and any queued or running tasks will be cancelled.
